notes.title: Play Party Pack 11 on October 23rd 2025 - Watch the Gameplay Trailer Now!
notes.notes:
[p][i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i] is coming to all major platforms on October 23, 2025. Check out this brand new gameplay trailer to preview the fun:[/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="a8IwlJvXhgk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]Get ready to play 5 hilarious new party games:[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Doominate [/i](Writing): Take a perfectly lovely situation and destroy it in this head-to-head joke game where it feels so good to be so bad. Doominate supports 3-8 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Hear Say[/i] (Sound Effects): Record sound effects and dialogue directly from your phone in a foley-inspired game where laughter is the soundtrack. Then, watch your voices come to life in a series of short movie clips! Hear Say supports 2-8 players. [/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Cookie Haus [/i](Drawing): Play our coziest and kookiest drawing game yet by fulfilling cookie design orders for unusual clientele. Don’t play on an empty stomach! Cookie Haus supports 3-8 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Suspectives[/i] (Social Deduction): There’s been a crime, one player secretly did it, and the evidence comes from your own survey answers! Study the clues, defend your innocence (even if you’re lying), and put your friends on trial. Suspectives supports 4-8 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Legends of Trivia [/i](Trivia): Assemble your team and put your trivia knowledge to the test in a fantastical world full of danger! Teamwork! Monsters! Do you dare take on one of the most challenging trivia games yet? Legends of Trivia supports 1-6 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Add Party Pack 11 to your [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364070/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_11/"][u]wishlist on Steam[/u][/url]![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Introducing the Fifth Game in Party Pack 11: Cookie Haus
notes.notes: [p]Welcome to [i]Cookie Haus[/i]! You’ve been hired as a cookie decorator for a bakery with an odd sort of clientele. Your job is to decorate cookies to their specifications… better than your fellow employees.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Kb0p6mUjApM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You’ll be given a cookie to decorate. That cookie might look like a crescent moon, but the customer has asked for it to look like “America’s Ugliest Dogs.” [/p][p]It’s time to frost. Choose from a variety of colors and frosting sizes. Add some sprinkles for pizazz. Then, give it a title to illustrate your creative vision.[/p][p]Cookie designs will then be shown in matchups with other bakers. Vote on your favorites, and assign kudos to other bakery masterpieces.[/p][p]Ready to start your shift? Well, the bakery isn’t open just yet. Add [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i] to your wishlist on Steam to be first in line at this cursed cookie consortium. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364070/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_11/" style="button"]WISHLIST PARTY PACK 11[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Trivia Murder Party 3 has been delayed
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve made the decision to delay [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048060/Trivia_Murder_Party_3/"]Trivia Murder Party 3[/url] into 2026. [/p][p][/p][p]From the beginning, Trivia Murder Party 3 has been one of our most ambitious projects yet. The game is being built in a new engine and it will be our first Jackbox title in recent years with online matchmaking. It is also the first title we hope to continuously update with new events and content after its release. [/p][p][/p][p]We know how much the Trivia Murder Party franchise means to our fans and to our team. We are excited to collaborate with our players to help Trivia Murder Party 3 evolve and we want to create the best possible starting point. We know that can only be achieved by giving our staff the space, time, and work environment to do what they do best. [/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to bring the party to you next year. In the meantime, you can follow our progress on the Trivia Murder Party 3 Steam page and on our blog. We look forward to sharing more with you soon. Thank you for your patience with us and for your support of our games for so many years.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Jackbox Games[/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][hr][/hr][h3]Want to stay up to date with the latest developments?[/h3][h2][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048060/Trivia_Murder_Party_3/" style="button"]Wishlist Trivia Murder Party 3[/url][/h2]

notes.title: The Jackbox Survey Scramble Patch is live!
notes.notes:
This free patch is now available for all major digital platforms including Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch. Dash on over to your game today to check out the new features, and read on to learn more about the new content that is now available. This patch features:

Two completely new game modes!
[list][*][b]DASH:[/b] Race to the finish line by picking the most popular answer from an array of choices. Confuse your opponents with decoy answers pulled from the list, or risk a double down to move further along the track.
[*][b]DARES:[/b] Challenge your opponents to reveal answers up and down the list. Will you give them a wide range to work with, or dare them to find something more niche?[/list]
A vast list of new gameplay settings to fit your party’s style, many based on your own feedback! Find these in the Settings menu:
[list][*]Not ready to walk away? Vote to play additional rounds in HILO and DARES
[*]Scrambled SQUARES mixes up the board, allowing the Squares answer ranges to appear in any order
[*]"Three Strikes" guessing mode in SQUARES: three guesses with no progress on the board ends your turn
[*]Unlimited SPEED disables the timer, reveal the entire list at your own pace!
[*]Fine-tune the ball speed and acceleration in BOUNCE, and skip the practice session
[*]Adjust the track length in DASH for longer or shorter games
[*]Point splitting for duplicate answers in HILO can now be disabled[/list]
Plus new music, bug fixes, stability improvements, some secret surprises, and more! And let’s not forget the list of updates we keep rolling out full of your latest answers. Thanks to everyone for playing the Survey Scramble, and keep the feedback and comments coming!
